gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — FREEZE BOTTLED WATER D-DAY RUNTIME PROFILE
parent_program: PlantOS #54 DDAY-FINAL-01 (VF SA reviews; do not hand to PlantOS PM)
objective: Define and implement one explicit D-Day runtime profile with realistic mixed cadence for the accepted Bottled Water workspace, mapping all 22 exported measurements to FAST/MEDIUM/SLOW/COUNT classes while keeping EVENT transport event-driven. Preserve dday-bw-b1-v2, topology, scenarios, timestamps, QoS-1 fail-closed ACK, zero signal/.../operating_state. No new engine. No PlantOS changes.

conservative_interpretation.issue_117_live_read: Issue #117 was readable. Execute FR1 only on accepted VF baseline 320d82f / dday-bw-b1-v2.
conservative_interpretation.profile: New machine-readable runtime.profile.yaml holds D-Day operating defaults, not a permanent industrial standard. B1 dictionary cadence strings stay as contract metadata. Live MQTT transport applies the profile; map_snapshot() stays a pure full projection.
conservative_interpretation.twenty_two: The 22 EXPORTED dictionary measurements are mapped 1:1. EVENT_ONLY operating_state rows stay event-driven. UNAVAILABLE rows stay unpublished.
conservative_interpretation.drive_load: Issue #117 named Capper motor current/vibration/speed/cycle/cap torque as FAST. drive_load is the remaining capper 1s electrical measurement and is mapped FAST so all 22 EXPORTED rows have a class.
conservative_interpretation.count: Production and FG integer counts use on-change plus an optional 10 s heartbeat.
conservative_interpretation.bounded_run: Prove a bounded live-transport run on the accepted ACK harness (equivalent to the internal broker path used by C01–C03). Do not optimize for a ~250 msg/s burst.
conservative_interpretation.keep: No new simulation engine. No PlantOS KPI/OEE. No topology/source-id/scenario meaning change. No operating_state as measurement. Retain QoS-1 ACK and deterministic source timestamps.
